annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Group on Ethics in Science and New Technologies (European Commission)
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for a collective, inclusive process of reflection and dialogue on values for AI, robotics and autonomous systems.
Proposes launching a process toward a common, internationally recognised ethical and legal framework.
Sets out fundamental ethical principles based on EU Treaties and the EU Charter of Fundamental Rights.
Notes current efforts are a patchwork of disparate initiatives.
annotation.summary_en: Catalogue page for the European Group on Ethics' March 2018 statement on AI, robotics and 'autonomous' systems. It calls for an inclusive process toward a common, internationally recognised ethical and legal framework and proposes fundamental ethical principles grounded in the EU Treaties and Charter of Fundamental Rights.
